Title: Ajay's Little Adventure

Cast

1. Ajay - 35 years, son
Look: blue shirt, black trousers
2. Kavita - 63 years, mother
Look: pink kurta, a long plait

Places

1. The office - desks, computers, a glass wall

Scene 1: The office - Day

[Ajay stands in the office. Kavita stands near him.]

Ajay: "Today feels like a good day."

[Ajay presses the lift button and waits.]

Ajay (laughing): "Yes, of course."

[Ajay checks his watch impatiently.]

Ajay: "Let's do this again tomorrow!"
